Olga: Quick Q from my lead: can we do a mid-cycle promotion that includes a base increase + equity refresh? What's the fastest path?

Mina (People Ops): Yes, possible but two parallel flows: comp-change form for pay + equity, and the grant request for RSUs (legal + comp review). Plan for separate approvals & timing.

Olga: Links? any required attachments?

forms-bot: comp-change form: <https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-change-format> • grant request: <https://redwood.internal/eq/grant-request> • attach: redacted offer (if retention), market comps, manager justification.

Jordan (Eng Manager): If we file both at once, will the equity grant align to the same effective date as salary?

Theo (Comp): Not necessarily. Salary follows payroll cycles (submit by the 7th for next-month effective). Equity grants run on quarterly grant dates and need legal sign-off; we can mark intent but grant date may differ.

Olga: If payroll cutoff misses next month, can we request retro-active pay?

Mina (People Ops): Retroactive pay is rare and requires Finance approval. Better to flag "urgent" on the form and include strong retention rationale.

Jordan (Eng Manager): What's considered strong retention rationale?

Theo (Comp): Competing offer with compensation details (redacted), clear impact statement (what loss would mean to roadmap), and available market data points. Attach all in the form to speed review.

Olga: Who signs off if proposed pay is above band?

Theo (Comp): Above band max -> VP People + Finance. If >20% over band, we escalate to executive approvals. Document the exception reason.

Jordan (Eng Manager): If comp is denied, is there a recommended manager script?

Mina (People Ops): Yes 1-line script in manager playbook: acknowledge, explain limits (band/budget), offer alternatives (one-time bonus, title-only, career plan) and timeline for re-review. See: <https://redwood.internal/hr/manager-playbook#comp-talks>.

Olga: Great, I'll prepare the forms and ping you for a quick pre-check Mina.

Theo (Comp): Happy to pre-check tomorrow morning.

forms-bot: Reminder: batch CSV available: <https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-batch-template.csv>

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks all, saving this for my leads.

Mina (People Ops): Thanks  reach out if you want a 10-min sync.
